newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU business confidence shows signs of improvement.
newsitem.headline: EU business confidence shows signs of improvement.

text.p: European Union businesses are showing moderate signs of optimism over current and future economic conditions, the European Commission said on Thursday.
In its September survey of economic sentiment, the Commission found that "industrialists expect production and selling-prices to recover, now that order books are returning to a normal level."

The slight uptick in business sentiment, which helped the EU's overall sentiment index rise to 99.0 in September from 98.7 in August, contrasted with relatively subdued trends among consumers and the construction industry, the survey added.
Among the 15-nation bloc, Germany and France showed no change in the overall economic sentiment index, although the former displayed a significant rebound in domestic orders expectations.
The better outlook for orders was also seen in several large EU economies.
On the consumer side, there was no improvement in any of the major economies except for Britain.
